title: New-Tire Credit on Readjustment Parts — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
A new-tire readjustment credit is taken off the parts charge of an Alignment Services & Plans readjustment, read from the vehicle's active Crestline tire set under Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty — its install date and whether its tire line includes a complimentary alignment check. The credit is worked out on its own and taken off the parts charge, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

| Vehicle's active Crestline tire set | Line includes a complimentary alignment check | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| installed no more than 30 calendar days before the readjustment (its date included) | Yes | 5.00 |
| installed no more than 30 calendar days before the readjustment | No | 2.50 |
| otherwise | — | 0.00 |

The 30 days are the tire bundle window of every Alignment Services & Plans line.

*Hypothetical:* a readjustment whose parts amount is 0.00 stays at 0.00 after the credit; a set installed 31 days before the readjustment gives no credit.
